name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands grounded in a wide stance, knees softly bent, both palms pressed down toward the earth as the ground ripples, then one hand sweeping up with fingers spread to lift a swirl of stones and dust around her, torso turned three-quarters, a calm, powerful gaze to the camera. A strong gust streams her fringe, sash and hair sideways. No weapon or staff - casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: Swirling stones, dust and motes of {{MAGIC}} light lift off the ground around her hands, tremors rippling the earth.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
